content: FOR. A deterministic e2e soak is the only gate that exercises crash-resume at production cadence: unit tests replay one boundary, the soak replays the full decision sequence — escalation tiers, send dedup, respawn windows, daemon-restart mail paths — under the exact intervals production uses. Scripted + fixed seed + recorded event log makes any run-to-run trace diff a reproducible bug by construction, converting "flaky" from a shrug into a regression artifact. It catches the midnight T3-halt class of failure no single test reproduces. Cheap to run headless; without it, the durable-loop claim ships on trust.
